About Autoeight

Autoeight is a web design, automation and data agency based in Halifax, West Yorkshire, United Kingdom. Founded by Adam Sheridan, the company helps growing UK businesses with three things: ranking websites that get found on Google and AI search, automations that save teams 10+ hours a week of manual work, and custom dashboards that turn raw data into clear decisions. Every build combines conversion-focused web design, AI integration, CRM connections, sales automation, and analytics reporting.

We've built websites and systems for clients across construction, education, retail, e-commerce, and professional services. Every site is custom-built (no templates), optimised for Google and AI search, mobile-first, and connected to the business tools our clients already use. Our differentiator is that we don't just hand over a website and walk away. We integrate it with your CRM, wire up automated lead capture, build the reporting layer that shows you what's working, and keep it all running long after launch.

Our Mission

Websites that rank on Google and AI search

Most agencies hand over a pretty website and disappear. We saw too many businesses end up with sites nobody could find. No search visibility, no lead capture, no follow-up, and no connection to the tools the team actually uses. A brochure you pay to host.

We built Autoeight to fix that. Every website we deliver is custom-designed and optimised for Google and AI search from day one, with proper technical SEO, structured data for rich results, local SEO across multiple regions, and content built for how ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude read the web. Our TM Joinery site now ranks on Page 1 in 6 UK regions. And because we hook your CRM up and wire in automated follow-up at the same time, the enquiries you earn from search don't slip through the cracks.

Why Automation?

See the difference automation makes

Most businesses are still doing everything by hand. Researching prospects, writing emails one at a time, chasing follow-ups, updating spreadsheets. It's slow, it's tiring, and it doesn't scale. Teams we automate typically save 10+ hours a week per person and four-times their output without hiring. Here's what it looks like when you stop doing all that manually.

Without Automation
Finding Prospects

Your team manually searches for leads, Googles each one individually, and copies their details into a spreadsheet. That's 2 hours gone before anyone's even sent a message.

⏲ 2 hrs wasted / day
Outreach

Every email gets written from scratch. LinkedIn messages go out one by one. There's no personalisation because there's no time for it. Generic messages get generic results.

⏲ 3 hrs wasted / day
Follow-ups

People forget to follow up. Leads go cold after 48 hours. The CRM doesn't get updated. Nobody knows what's been sent to who. Deals slip through the cracks.

⚠ Revenue lost
5+ hours wasted per person, per day
With Automation
Finding Prospects

AI finds your ideal prospects automatically. It pulls data from LinkedIn, the web, and social profiles, then builds a full prospect profile for each one. No manual searching.

⚡ 2 hrs saved / day
Outreach

AI writes personalised emails using real data about each prospect. LinkedIn messages go out automatically. Your CRM updates itself. Every message is tailored, and you didn't write a single one.

⚡ 3 hrs saved / day
Follow-ups

Follow-ups go out at exactly the right time, across email and LinkedIn, 24/7. When a lead gets hot, the system flags it and your team steps in to close. No leads go cold. No deals get forgotten.

⚡ Deals closed on autopilot
5+ hours saved per person, per day

Data & Insights

See the numbers your competitors miss

Most businesses are sitting on data they never look at. Sales activity in the CRM, traffic in Google Analytics, bookings in the calendar, stock in the warehouse. It's all there, but it lives in ten places and nobody has time to pull it together. So decisions get made on gut feel.

We build the reporting layer that sits on top. Custom dashboards that pull your numbers into one view, funnel and conversion reporting that shows where enquiries actually drop off, SEO performance tracking across every page and keyword, and anomaly alerts when something moves. You stop guessing and start acting on what the data is telling you.

  • Custom dashboards that pull CRM, sales, traffic and ops data into one view.
  • Funnel & conversion reporting that shows where leads are actually dropping off.
  • SEO performance tracking across every page, keyword and region you rank in.
  • Bottleneck detection so you spot the step in your process that's costing the most time.
  • Automated weekly reports delivered by email so nobody has to log in and dig.
  • Anomaly alerts when a number moves in a way you should know about.
Our Values

How we work and what we care about

Results First

We measure everything by what it actually does for your business. If it's not going to move the needle, we won't build it.

Full Transparency

No black boxes. You'll always know what we've built, how it works, and what it's doing. It's your system, you should be able to see everything.

Long-Term Partnership

We don't build something and vanish. We stick around, keep things running, and improve your systems as your business grows.

Precision Over Speed

We take the time to properly understand your business before we touch anything. The right solution, built well, beats a rushed one every time.

Always Learning

AI moves fast. So do we. We're constantly updating how we work so your systems always use the best tools and methods available.

Human First

Automation should free people up to do better work, not replace them. We build systems that make teams stronger, not smaller.
